clean_body: Thanks for the compliments, and dude this is such an excellent question. This car has been my aspiration for … ever. It was something I thought would remain forever out of reach, until it wasn’t. The moment I realized that I could afford the cash component and that I was willing to let go of the Turbo S, I started looking. That was around the beginning of July. I researched price history on classic.com, found comps in the market, and started talking to sellers. This deal happened because I got enough trade-in value to make it work. Sure, I was worried about price going up. People say things like the 992.2 GT2RS will cause older model values to skyrocket. Maybe they will? At the end of the day I’m just too stupid to time markets or predict the future so I made peace with where things were, right now. Would it work, right now? Was this car The One? Answer was yes, so I did it. So I would not frame this as a rush to action. Only you know your pocketbook, and if you can do it now without jeopardizing anything critical, then my advice is to do it now. Nobody’s guaranteed a tomorrow. Just imagine the smile on my face when I stood there this morning with a cup of coffee looking at this ridiculous thing. Priceless. That’s what it’s all about.
